syllabus_topics: Modeling enterprise architectures with the ArchiMate language
Modeling business processes with the BPMN language
Process and techniques for requirements development
Process and techniques for requirements management
Modeling information systems with the UML language
Modeling cyber-physical and physical systems with the SysML language
Requirements Specification: Objectives, Scenarios, Use Cases, Stories, Non-Functional Requirements, Constraints
assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) is calculated as 60% of the Theoretical Grade (NT) and 40% of the Practical Grade (NP). For the normal period, NT and NP are used. For student-workers, NT can be obtained through an exam or continuous assessment, and NP can be group-based or an individual project (requiring early contact with the professor). For the special period, NT is based on a special period exam, and NP can be reused from the normal period or a new project can be arranged (requiring early contact with the professor).
